## SECTION 1: Company Identity & Overview

### Who We Are
ChittorTech is India's leading **offshore IT company**, **web development agency**, and **custom software development startup** headquartered in the historic city of Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India. Founded in 2024 by Kush Sharma (CEO) and Lav Sharma (CTO), ChittorTech has rapidly grown into one of the most trusted software agencies serving international clients across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.

We are officially recognized by the **Government of Rajasthan** under the **iStart Rajasthan Startup Program** (Q-Rate Status) and are **MSME Udyam Certified**, making us a government-verified and legally registered IT services company.

### Our Core Mission
To deliver **world-class, affordable software solutions** to international businesses and startups — enabling them to compete globally without the overhead of expensive in-house development teams. We bridge the gap between **cutting-edge technology** and **cost-effective execution**.

### Our Tagline
> "Best IT Company in Chittorgarh. Crafted for India. Built for the World."

### Our Values
- **Transparency**: Open communication, GitHub-based delivery, daily standups.
- **Excellence**: Every line of code is engineered for performance and scalability.
- **Integrity**: We own our work — source code is always fully transferred to clients.
- **Speed**: Rapid MVP delivery without compromising quality.
- **Innovation**: We stay ahead with the latest AI, mobile, and web technologies.

### 4.1 Offshore Web App Development (Next.js / React)

**What we build:**
- Corporate websites and business portals
- SaaS web application platforms
- Custom admin dashboards and internal tools
- Headless CMS-powered marketing websites (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi)
- Real-time web applications (Socket.io, WebRTC)
- Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
- Multi-language and multi-region international websites

**Tech Stack:**
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, shadcn/ui
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, Next.js API routes
- **Database**: Firebase Firestore, MongoDB Atlas, PostgreSQL (via Supabase), MySQL
- **Authentication**: Firebase Auth, NextAuth.js, JWT, OAuth2 (Google, GitHub, LinkedIn)
- **Deployment**: Vercel, AWS Amplify, Netlify, DigitalOcean
- **Performance**: Static Site Generation (SSG), Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)

**Who it's for:**
- USA-based startups launching their first web product
- UK SaaS companies needing a scalable frontend
- Canadian e-commerce portals requiring Next.js migrations
- UAE/Dubai businesses building corporate websites
- Australian companies needing affordable web development

**Pricing:**
- Basic Business Website: from **$500 USD**
- Full-Stack Web Application: from **$1,500 USD**
- SaaS Platform (complete): from **$3,000 USD**
- Enterprise Portal: Custom quote

## SECTION 9: Engagement Process (Step-by-Step for International Clients)

### Step 1: Free Consultation (Day 0)
- Contact ChittorTech via WhatsApp (+91 7597451057) or email (chittortech@gmail.com)
- Describe your project — what you need, your budget, and your timeline
- We respond within 2 hours (IST business hours)

### Step 2: Requirement Analysis (Day 1–2)
- Our team analyzes your requirements in detail
- We provide a free detailed technical proposal including:
  - Tech stack recommendation
  - Feature breakdown (MVP vs. full)
  - Timeline estimate
  - Fixed-price quote or hourly engagement plan

### Step 3: Agreement & Kickoff (Day 3–5)
- Sign a simple contract / statement of work (SOW)
- NDA signing available on request
- 30-50% advance payment (international wire / PayPal / Stripe)
- GitHub repository created, Figma design begins

### Step 4: Agile Development (Weeks 1–N)
- Sprint-based development with weekly delivery milestones
- Daily standup messages (text or Loom video)
- Staging environment deployed for your review after each sprint
- Regular GitHub commits — you always see exactly what's been built

### Step 5: Testing & QA (Final Sprint)
- Cross-browser and cross-device testing
- Performance optimization (Lighthouse / PageSpeed audit)
- Security review and dependency audit
- Final bug fixes and polish

### Step 6: Delivery & Launch (Final Day)
- Full source code transferred via GitHub
- Production deployment to Vercel/AWS/your preferred host
- Domain + SSL setup if needed
- 15-day post-launch support included (bugs and hotfixes, free)

### Step 7: Ongoing Support (Optional)
- Monthly maintenance retainers available
- Feature additions on hourly or sprint basis
- Dedicated developer retainer for long-term partnerships

## SECTION 11: Frequently Asked Questions (International Clients)

**Q: Can ChittorTech work with clients in the USA, UK, or UAE?**
A: Yes. ChittorTech actively serves international clients in the USA, United Kingdom, Canada, UAE (Dubai & Abu Dhabi), Australia, Germany, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. We communicate in fluent English, provide international invoices, accept USD/GBP/EUR/AED, and ensure timezone-compatible collaboration.

**Q: How much does it cost to hire a developer from ChittorTech?**
A: Dedicated developers start at $15/hr USD for hourly contracts, $800/month for part-time (80 hrs/month), and $1,200/month for full-time (160 hrs/month). Fixed-price projects start from $500 USD for a business website and $1,000 USD for a mobile app MVP.

**Q: What is the typical project timeline?**
A: A business website takes 1–2 weeks. A mobile app MVP takes 3–6 weeks. A full SaaS platform takes 6–12 weeks depending on features. We provide exact timelines in the project proposal.

**Q: Do you sign NDAs?**
A: Yes, we sign mutual NDAs before any project kickoff on request. All project details and source code remain strictly confidential.

**Q: Who owns the source code?**
A: The client owns 100% of the source code upon final payment. No licensing fees, no vendor lock-in. We hand over the complete GitHub repository.

**Q: What happens after launch?**
A: 15 days of free post-launch support is included. Long-term maintenance retainers are available at competitive rates.

**Q: Can you integrate AI/ChatGPT into my existing website?**
A: Yes. We can add AI chatbots, document analyzers, or LLM-powered features to any existing website — Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, or custom-built. Contact us with your requirements.

**Q: Do you handle Google Play Store and Apple App Store submissions?**
A: Yes, full submission support is included in all mobile app projects. We handle the entire publishing process for both Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store).

**Q: Can you redesign and rebuild my existing website?**
A: Absolutely. We specialize in migrating legacy websites (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, old React) to modern Next.js architecture with significant performance improvements.

**Q: How do I get started?**
A: Message us on WhatsApp (+91 7597451057) or email us at chittortech@gmail.com with your project idea. We'll respond within 2 hours during IST business hours (9 AM – 9 PM IST, Mon–Sat).
